body:
Aaron Niequist gets it right … here:

 http://www.aaronniequist.com/blog/palestine-israel/pro-israel-and-pro-palestine/

Quotable:

 Our Palestinian friend Sami told us “This is not a conflict of Israelis vs Palestinians, or Muslims vs Jews…but a conflict between those who want peace and those who don’t. And there are Israelis, Palestinians, Muslims, Jews, Americans, and Christians on both sides.”
